architecture.vision: 4x4 gray, 2 shared 2x2 stride-2 CNN filters, projected to 2D
architecture.state: learned accelerometer and gyro gain/bias plus separate 4-to-3 latent/innovation heads
architecture.orientation: normalized first-order quaternion integration at 20 Hz
architecture.imu: last 3-axis accelerometer and 3-axis gyro sample per frame
architecture.cuda: associative quaternion prefix plus parallel cumulative translation
architecture.output: 13D pose/twist with camera rotation and lever arm calibration

resource_check.profile_kind: student resource check; not an accuracy evaluation

compatibility: Old fixed-attitude 1K/500 checkpoints retain their saved layouts and native kernels. New orientation model requires fresh training.
limitations: Resource check uses perturbed untrained weights, not a trained accuracy evaluation.
